# ELEMENTS 2.0

Elements 2.0 is a bold, non-chill filtered whisky showing the flavour impact of an extended fermentation process. The result is fruity and smoky, with notes of stewed green apples, zesty orange peel and smoky peat.

**Awarded Whisky of the Year 2024, by the Whisky Advocate.**

## Tasting Notes

_![Tawny and auburn tones.](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-06/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_color-01_0.png.webp?itok=KMiTACf9)_

### Colour

Bold, pale gold

_![Aroma of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-06/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_aroma-01.png.webp?itok=sM8XkwXI)_

### Nose

Fruity and subtly coastal. Stewed apples, vanilla custard and zesty orange peel with subtle peaty notes.

_![Tasting Notes of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-06/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_taste-01.png.webp?itok=Mp9O9tWi)_

### Palate

Fruity, sweet and salty. Green apples and runny honey with cream soda and soft peatiness of a smouldering bonfire and smoked seafood.

_![Finish of Laphroaig Scotch Whisky](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2022-06/LAPHROAIG_website_icon_finish-01.png.webp?itok=SA9oEcWf)_

### Finish

Sweet with an increasingly warming smokiness to finish.

Every flavour is big and bold with its own place, each one complementing the other. **The extended fermentation of up to 115 hours introduced some extra tropical fruit notes which perfectly balanced with the soft smokiness of the peat**.

On the nose, you’ll notice intensity of the peat smoke and green apple, followed by a warmth of ginger. More smoke comes when you taste, along with runny honey, cream soda and vanilla. The long and lingering finish “leaves smokiness sitting like a blanket”, with a hint of red berries.

[Learn More about Elements 2.0](https://www.laphroaig.com/whisky-stories/elements-2-0 "Learn More about Elements 2.0")

![Laphroaig_Articlecard_Elements2](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2024-04/Laphroaig_Articlecard_Elements2_V1.jpg.webp?itok=ku2EvuQt)

"There are all the classic flavours you might recognise from Laphroaig but with an extra dimension. The finish is just incredible. This is a really good Laphroaig, actually. Fantastic."

![Laphroaig_HPBanner_Elements2](https://www.laphroaig.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2024-04/Laphroaig_HPBanner_Elements2_V1.jpg.webp?itok=3xSnObj9)

You know we don’t like to follow the crowd, so rather than focus entirely on cask finishes or different styles to bring out, the Elements Series allows us to explore how we can engineer different flavours.

Distilled during a particularly frosty January, **Elements 2.0 takes fermentation beyond our standard of 55 hours and experimented with of a range of longer fermentations, all the way up to 115 hours**.

The effect of this longer fermentation period is an intensity of flavour. After around 65 hours, a secondary fermentation begins to kick in inside the washback and this reintroduces some more tropical flavours, while retaining the classic Laphroaig character we all know and love.

Your first taste of 2.0 will bring those strong flavours together as well as more smoke, gooseberries, with some nuttiness and vanilla. At the end, you get lingering red berries and a powerful, long smoky finish.

Elements 2.0 Faq

## \#\#\# Is Laphroaig Elements 2.0 a limited-edition release?

Yes. Laphroaig Elements 2.0 is a [**limited-edition Scotch**](https://www.laphroaig.com/whiskies/limited-edition) release in our experimental Elements series. It was created to explore the flavour impact of extended fermentation, offering a bold, non-chill filtered expression of Laphroaig with extra tropical fruit notes, soft peat smoke, and a long, warming finish.

## \#\#\# How does Elements 2.0 compare with the rest of the Laphroaig Elements series?

Each release in the Elements series explores a different part of our [**Scotch whisky-making process**](https://www.laphroaig.com/how-to-make-whisky). Elements 1.0 looked at innovation in mashing and fermentation, while Elements 2.0 focuses on extended fermentation of up to 115 hours. Rather than being better or stronger than another chapter, Elements 2.0 shows a different side of Laphroaig, bringing fruit, sweetness, soft smoke, and layered complexity into balance.

## \#\#\# What makes Elements 2.0 different from the classic Laphroaig style?

Elements 2.0 is still unmistakably Laphroaig, but it brings an extra dimension to our classic [**peated whisky**](https://www.laphroaig.com/whisky-stories/peated-whisky) style. The extended fermentation introduces more tropical fruit notes, balancing the peat with green apple, runny honey, cream soda, vanilla, and a softer smokiness. It keeps the bold Islay character you know, while revealing a fruitier, more layered side of the [**whisky distillery**](https://www.laphroaig.com/distillery).

## \#\#\# What did Laphroaig 2.0 to earn “Whisky of the Year 2024”?

Laphroaig Elements 2.0 was awarded Whisky of the Year 2024 by The Whisky Advocate for the way it pushes our process while staying true to our character. Its extended fermentation brings every flavour into its own place, with fruit, sweetness, salt, and smoke working together. The result is bold, balanced, and distinctly Laphroaig.

## \#\#\# If you love 10 Year Cask Strength, what does Elements 2.0 bring that’s different?

If you enjoy the full, uncompromising character of [**Laphroaig 10 Year Cask Strength**](https://www.laphroaig.com/whiskies/10-year-old-cask-strength-batch-12-single-malt-scotch-whisky), Elements 2.0 brings a different kind of intensity. Where 10 Year Cask Strength is powerful, direct, and shaped by cask strength depth, Elements 2.0 is shaped by extended fermentation of up to 115 hours. That longer fermentation brings brighter fruit notes and softer peat smoke, adding a more experimental layer to our unmistakable Islay character.
